sections.heading: Vehicle safety reporting, equipment and tires
sections.markdown:
## C — Vehicle safety reporting, equipment and tires

FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A37
NHTSA collects reports about possible safety problems in vehicles and equipment, including tires and child safety seats. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A37
Reporting a vehicle safety problem may help identify a defect that leads to a recall. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A37
The handbook's required lighting equipment includes headlights, tail lamps, brake lamps and turn indicators. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A37
A horn, windshield wipers and a muffler are included in the required-equipment list. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A37
The required seat-belt equipment depends on the vehicle's manufacturing year. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A37
The handbook requires both a service-brake system and a parking-brake system. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A37
Every vehicle window is required to use safety glass. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A37
The equipment list specifies pneumatic tires with tread measuring at least two thirty-seconds of an inch. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A37
Objects hung or posted in a window may not obstruct the driver's view. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A37
The handbook directs owners to use their vehicle identification number when checking for manufacturer safety recalls. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A37
The VIN is usually found near the lower corner below the windshield. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A37
Many vehicles have a spring-loaded device that locks the steering wheel when the ignition key reaches the lock position. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A37
Do not move the ignition to its lock position while the vehicle is moving, because steering control can be lost. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A37
The handbook recommends inspecting the steering-wheel lock during routine maintenance. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A37
The handbook forbids windshield sunscreen material below the AS-1 line unless that material is clear and transparent. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A37
The printed front-side-window rule does not allow luminous reflectance above thirty-five percent. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A37
The printed front-side-window rule does not allow light transmission below thirty-five percent. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A37
The printed rear-window rule does not allow luminous reflectance above thirty-five percent. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A37
The printed rear-window rule does not allow light transmission below twenty percent. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A37
The handbook classifies owning or operating a vehicle in violation of its window restrictions as a Class III misdemeanor. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> pdf-0037]

Misconceptions: The pressure molded on a tire sidewall is not the vehicle's recommended operating pressure; a penny check does not settle every roadworthiness question.
Mnemonics: Cold tire, vehicle label, correct pressure; inspect the tread too.
Glossary: PSI measures tire pressure; VIN identifies the vehicle; service and parking brakes are the two listed brake systems.
Dynamic facts: Live contact details, services and variable fees are withheld from this stable inventory.
